static_traits.name: Zhang Wei
static_traits.social_status: Weak social support, alienated from relatives and friends due to guilt
static_traits.medical_history: No obvious physical illness; no similar psychological problems before; has not received psychotherapy或咨询
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to self-Reflect, Good cooperation; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: Because all three cats have been sick recently, I feel I am a bad cat mother, which makes me very distressed and full of guilt.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeks help due to the overwhelming pain and guilt brought by the cat's illness, hoping to obtain support and guidance.

core_beliefs: I am a terrible cat mom
My negligence will harm what I love

special_situations.event: Three cats falling ill one after another in a short time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的猫生病了,就说明我have not尽到照护责任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断上网查养猫知识,加倍清洁环境,频繁联系Veterinarian以弥补'过失'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault,I am a terrible cat mom

special_situations.event: 看到猫not舒服或症状加重时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: A good owner should have detected and prevented all diseases earlier
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly self-examines, demands of oneself with 'shoulds' to provide perfect care
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该更早发现并带它们去看Doctor

special_situations.event: Veterinariannot yet指出她有任何过错
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 即使have not明确证据,我也应为负面结果负责
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视中性或正面信息,Reinforcement自责与过度归因
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是have not明说,其实是我让猫生病了

special_situations.event: When thinking about the cat's illness at work or in life
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我真的在乎,就not该体验快乐或投入其他事务
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 自我惩罚(Avoids socializing,降低自我照顾),用内疚压制积极体验
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 在它们受苦时我not配开心或专注Work

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be a reliable caregiver who can protect what they love
core_conflict.fear: 害怕自己的疏忽会伤害所爱之物并被视为not负责任
defense_goal: Avoids repeating mistakes through self-blame and strict self-demands
Maintains high control and vigilance to feel safe

object_relations.object_representation: A fragile, dependent cat that needs protection (the one being cared for)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked 'what evidence is there that you caused the cat's illness' or encouraged to test the self-blame with facts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向将not可控的因素理解为自己的失职,并认为必须做到完美照护
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气内疚而谨慎,频繁use'我应该...''It is all my fault',淡化外部因素,难以接受安慰或中性证据.

manifestations: Actively distances from friends and family out of guilt
Weak social support; lacks outlets for confiding

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact
manifestations: 频繁自责并以'我not配开心'限制自己
Overly cautious when in contact with others, tends to retreat into self-criticism

contact_model.definition: 个体克制想对其他人或物做出某个行为的冲动,或是放弃了向外寻求do not人为其做某事,转而对自己做
manifestations: Could have sought support from friends and family but chose self-isolation
Turns concern and energy into self-punishment (worsening guilt) rather than expressing and seeking help

positive_force: Has a stable attachment and trust with the three cats (still seeks her comfort when sick)
Able to proactively take care actions (seek medical care promptly, look up care materials)
具备自我Reflection与现实检验的意愿(可识do not事实与情绪的not一致)
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as personalization, overgeneralization, and mind reading intensify guilt
Weak social support and self-isolates due to guilt
Berates oneself with 'should' statements, pursuing perfect caregiving
Persistent self-punishment and emotional reasoning lead to functional impairment (work, daily life, self-care)

antecedent: Seeing or thinking about the three cats' illness
在日常Work或自我照护过程中回忆猫的not适
target_behavior.core_reason: Personalizes the cat's illness as their own dereliction of duty, and demands of themselves with 'should' statements and perfection standards (overgeneralization, mind reading, emotional reasoning)
target_behavior.function: 通过自责获得道德上的控制感与自我惩罚以缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired work performance, disrupted daily self-care, intensified emotional distress

antecedent: When friends or family try to reach out
target_behavior.core_reason: 认为在猫受苦时自己not配享受社交与支持,担心被视为not负责任
target_behavior.function: 逃避来自他人的接触与可能的评价,减少not适情绪
target_behavior.consequence: Social support进一步下降,Loneliness与痛苦增加
